title: Publish the stop, turn and sideways videos of the 512-robot seeds
summary: Seed 20260918's forward-to-stop video recorded on a retry after the first launch lost the GPU lock race. Two further evaluations of seed 20260917 repeat all 13 probes with the camera on the +0.20 rad/s turn and on the 90-degree translation; every verdict and yaw metric equals the first trial, so the evaluation is deterministic at a fixed seed. The turn video is the program's first recorded turn pass. Two focus-scope attempts that could not host those cases stay retained. No result changes.
reason: The videos illustrate the recorded result and change no verdict or acceptance.
